sn17.6:1.3: The phrasing here is odd, but the regular syntax in the two phrases (object in accusative, subject in nominative, verb in imperative) suggests it is not corrupt. I think the Buddha is quoting a saying, a curse perhaps, then he substitutes the Dhammic meaning. See Atharva Veda 8.4.20: “Let Indra hurl his lightning at the sorcerers!” | For _asanivicakkaṁ_ (“forked lightning”) see Rig Veda 4.35.2 where _vicakra_ means “divided”.
